purpose: Teach: 優越/数理/復刊/論説/前項/想起/体現/個所

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民に対し優越的な態度を絶対に取られませんね
lines.en: The police never adopt a superior attitude toward citizens.
lines.style: Measured, professional tone. Light emphasis on the negation. Respectful but assured—speaking as someone who knows what he's observed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪統計を数理的に分析されますね
lines.en: The police conduct mathematical analysis of crime statistics.
lines.style: Calm, straightforward delivery. Even pacing. Slight nod of approval implicit in the tone—noting competence without fanfare.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯ハンドブックの復刊もご検討ですね
lines.en: The police are considering reissuing their crime prevention handbook.
lines.style: Thoughtful acknowledgment. Gentle upward lift on 'considering'—genuine recognition of the effort involved.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、ご自身の論説を市民向けに発表されますね
lines.en: The police share their professional insights with the public.
lines.style: Earnest, warm undertone. Slightly slower pace on 'share'—emphasizing the generosity of the act.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、調書の前項を確認されますね
lines.en: The police review previous sections of witness statements carefully.
lines.style: Methodical, precise. Steady rhythm. The voice of someone noting procedural diligence without dramatizing it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、目撃証言を想起しやすくする工夫もされますね
lines.en: The police take care to help witnesses recall what they've seen.
lines.style: Gentle emphasis on 'help'—not condescending, but noting the thoughtfulness behind the technique. Slower, deliberate pacing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民安全を体現する活動を続けられますね
lines.en: The police continue to embody and demonstrate public safety.
lines.style: Steady conviction. Warm but measured. A slight lean forward—genuine respect for sustained commitment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査資料の重要個所を被害者にもご説明されますね
lines.en: The police explain important details from investigation documents to victims as well.
lines.style: Direct, firm but not harsh. Slight emphasis on 'victims'—acknowledging the care in including them. Closer to conversational intimacy.
